title: Recurrence, Transience, and the Rate of Escape for Elephant Random Walks with Two Memory Channels
summary: We study the one-dimensional elephant random walk with two memory channels introduced by Saha [Phys.\ Rev.\ E \textbf{106}, L062105 (2022)] with memory parameter $p\in(0,1)$. Maulik, Roy and Sadhukhan [arXiv:2509.10225] proved recurrence for $p\le11/16$ and transience for $p>7/8$, leaving the range $11/16<p\le7/8$ open. We close this gap by proving that $p=11/16$ is the exact recurrence--transience threshold and by determining how fast the walk escapes from the origin throughout the transient regime.
